Cendryma Bio

Hailing from the verdant landscapes of Oregon, USA, Daniel Sampson a.k.a. Cendryma weaves
the raw power of nature into the fabric of his music. Growing up in the lush Pacific Northwest,
Cendryma's sound mirrors the elements, with rain samples, driving basslines, and darker tones
reflecting the region's moody winters. His compositions are deeply textured, blending captivating
melodies with dynamic, emotive atmospheres.

Daniel began his electronic music journey in 2007, but it wasn’t until 2017 that he publicly
released his first Trance tracks under the Tecnosine alias. By 2020, he exclusively pursued
Downtempo, marking his first major creative transition. His early career was shaped by trance,
but as time passed, he grew constrained by its rigid structures. In 2022, he introduced the Sam
Cydan moniker, debuting his first major release under the new name. That same year, the
pandemic spurred his exploration of Progressive House, culminating in the birth of Cendryma in
2023, a project that truly embodies his evolving sound and creative vision.

Influenced by artists like Alex O’Rion, GMJ & Matter, and Anjunadeep’s Marsh, Cendryma has
shaped his signature sound in Progressive House, steering clear of conventional boundaries. His
productions flow organically, evolving over time, while his label, ‘Cydana Sounds,’ serves as an
intimate platform for his musical explorations.

With tracks like "Function" and his debut EP Terraform/Wired gaining recognition, his recent
release, "Pass Through," on Purrfection Records, is already making huge waves. As he looks to
the future, Cendryma is set to expand his influence in the global Progressive House scene with
upcoming releases on labels like Pattern and UV, continuing to refine and evolve his sound. His
journey has only just begun!

-Text by Levitate Music (@levitate_music)
